Example letter
JF
Jamaul Ford · Making Stacks The morning count runs before I do

The fix

A morning system at our family daycare that checks the staff in and counts the meals, before I ever get there.

How to pull it

Every weekday morning it reads who has checked in, counts the children present in each class, and tallies the meals for the food program. Then it cross-checks the two lists, so a class count that doesn’t match gets flagged, and sends the team the numbers by text and email.

What it gave back

The morning no longer starts with phone calls and head counts. The team opens with the numbers in hand, the food program paperwork starts right, and anything off is caught that morning, not weeks later at claim time.
